SETTINGS_TICK_RES_DEFAULT_DESC: ⚠ 翻訳待ち — 説明は英語で表示されます。 Backwards-compatible with existing snapshots and lessons. Fastest runs and lowest memory. Clocks above 50 MHz alias down to 50 MHz.
SETTINGS_TICK_RES_HIGH_DESC: ⚠ 翻訳待ち — 説明は英語で表示されます。 Accurate visualisation up to 500 MHz. Expect ~10x slower simulations and ~10x more signal-history memory per run.
SETTINGS_TICK_RES_ADAPTIVE_DESC: ⚠ 翻訳待ち — 説明は英語で表示されます。 Picks the coarsest tick that still gives at least two ticks per clock period. Only pays the precision cost when the effective clock needs it.

HOME_TITLE: Kmila-9s: マルチプラットフォームVHDL学習・デバッグツール
HOME_SUBTITLE: 物理ハードウェアなしでVHDLコードを学習・デバッグするためのアプリケーション。
HOME_OVERVIEW_P1: Kmila-9sは、ローカル環境で動作するマルチプラットフォームデスクトップアプリケーションで、VHDL（超高速集積回路ハードウェア記述言語）コードのデバッグを目的としています。デジタル信号、クロックサイクル、ポート状態のシミュレーションとインタラクティブな可視化を通じてプログラム分析を容易にすることを目標としています。
HOME_OVERVIEW_P2: このプロジェクトは、FPGA（フィールドプログラマブルゲートアレイ）向けデジタル設計の学術学習をサポートすることを目指し、物理ハードウェアなしでデジタルシステムのロジックを実践的に理解できる、無料でオープンソースのツールを提供しています。
HOME_FEATURE_VISUALIZATION_DESC: いつでも信号、ポート、内部変数の状態を観察できます。

LEARN_SUBTITLE: From your very first bit to a pipelined CPU — guided readings, worked samples, fix-the-bug exercises, and full projects. Track your progress and open anything straight into the Kmila editor.
LEARN_EMPTY_BODY: The curriculum manifest couldn't be loaded. Try reopening the app or check the logs.
LEARN_LESSON_NOT_FOUND_BODY: That lesson isn't in the current curriculum. It may have been renamed or removed.
LEARN_LESSON_BODY_MISSING: The reading for this lesson hasn't been translated yet — showing the English version as a fallback.
LEARN_FALLBACK_TO_EN: 英語版を表示しています — このレッスンはまだ翻訳されていません。
LEARN_TRACK_BEGINNER_BLURB: Binary, boolean algebra, gates — the mental model you need before you write a single line of VHDL.
LEARN_TRACK_EASY_BLURB: VHDL syntax, combinational design, simulation. Short lessons, one concept each.
LEARN_TRACK_INTERMEDIATE_BLURB: Processes, flip-flops, counters, finite-state machines — the moment static circuits start to remember.
LEARN_TRACK_ADVANCED_BLURB: Memories, ALUs, small CPUs, bus protocols. Multi-module designs where pieces talk to each other.
LEARN_TRACK_EXPERT_BLURB: Pipelining, hazards, verification, SoC integration. The material from a Sistemas en Chip or Computer Architecture course.
LEARN_SAMPLE_TRY_BODY: Create a throw-away project seeded with this sample and jump straight to the workbench.
LEARN_SAMPLE_FIX_BODY: We give you a design that doesn't quite work. Open it, find the bug, make it build and simulate correctly.
LEARN_SAMPLE_PROJECT_BODY: Open the starter scaffold and build the design from there. Acceptance criteria and sample stimuli are in the reading above.
RUNBAR_FPGA_REQUIRED: Pick an FPGA in the top bar before you Build or Run — we need a target to validate resource usage against.
EDITOR_WAVE_NO_DATA: Simulation finished but produced no signal traces.
EDITOR_WAVE_NO_DATA_HINT: Usually this means no stimulus was defined — open the Ports tab, add a few moments for your input signals, then Run again.
SETTINGS_USER_FPGAS_SUB: Download a starter template, add your own device in JSON, then import it here. User-added devices appear alongside the bundled ones in the top-bar picker.
SETTINGS_USER_LANGS_SUB: Bring your own translation. File name becomes the language code; include a __LANG_NAME__ entry for the display name.
SETTINGS_USER_LANGS_NOTE: User languages are merged into the language picker after import. They override the bundled file when both share a code.
SETTINGS_NO_USER_FPGA: No custom FPGAs yet. Import one to see it in the TopBar picker.
SETTINGS_NO_USER_LANG: No custom languages yet. Download the template to get started.
SETTINGS_FPGA_IMPORTED: FPGA imported — pick it in the TopBar.
SETTINGS_LANG_IMPORTED: Language imported — pick it in the TopBar.
SETTINGS_IMPORT_FAILED: Import failed — is the JSON valid?
LEARN_CONTINUE_ARIA: Resume from the last lesson you opened
LEARN_NO_MATCH_BODY: Nothing in the curriculum matches "{0}". Clear the search to see everything.
SETTINGS_LEARN_SUB: Track and reset the lessons you've marked complete.
SETTINGS_LEARN_RESET_MSG: This removes every lesson you've marked complete and forgets where you left off. The lessons themselves stay intact.
EDITOR_CONFIG_AUTOAPPLY_MISSING: Couldn't find the saved configuration '{0}'. Port moments weren't auto-applied — load one manually from the Configurations pill.
EDITOR_EMPTY_RUNS: No captured runs yet for this project.
RUNS_EMPTY_HINT: Every successful simulation lands here automatically — run your design once to populate the list.
RUNS_DELETE_CONFIRM: Delete run "{0}" — this cannot be undone.
RUNS_LOAD_FAILED: Couldn't replay this run — the stored waveform looks corrupted.
RUNBAR_CLOCK_CUSTOM_TOOLTIP: Custom clock — may cause very long simulations or mismatched resource estimates. Click the reset button to return to the FPGA default.
PORT_CLOCK_AUTO_NOTE: The system clock drives this port automatically at the frequency set in the Run bar.
PORT_CLOCK_AUTO_TOOLTIP: Auto-driven by the FPGA's system clock — edit the Run bar to change the frequency.
